## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials + Industrials both negative; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%); Utilities marginally positive but no broad uplift. Only two sectors positive — narrow leadership concentrated in Energy.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Industrials lag: EMR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%), GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -4.08%). Healthcare/Consumer names weak: LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%), HD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.76% | 1M: -12.11%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.38% | 1M: +15.33%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.64% | 1M: +11.12%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy); Style: Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: EMR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.43% | 1M: -10.56%), PSA BELOW TREND (1W: -5.54% | 1M: -3.76%), EL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -17.60%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.21% | 1M: -1.19%). Weakness concentrated across Industrials, Materials and pockets of Technology.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Upside momentum concentrated in Energy/Select Industrials: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.73% | 1M: +17.88%), UBER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +11.14%); downside momentum in LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%). Note MAJOR divergence: TSLA (POTENTIAL REVERSAL), UNH (POTENTIAL REVERSAL) and PFE (POTENTIAL REVERSAL) — tactical uncertainty, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech broadly soft with mixed pockets: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -0.25%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) while GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +1.77%) and AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +8.25%); overall tech under pressure and showing weakness.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials weak/rolling over: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -5.18%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -1.79%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.58% | 1M: -2.27%) — sector contribution is negative and confirms RISK-OFF backdrop.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare showing defensive strains with dispersion: JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -1.67%), UNH POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.15%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%) — watch drug/earnings headlines for idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy cyclicals (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%)) and reduce exposure to stretched Tech names showing weakness (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%)). Style: Value/Cyclical favored; maintain caution given leadership concentration and divergence in large caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +14.95%).  
BEARISH: INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.83%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -10.54%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (clear momentum and earnings/news catalysts).  
BEARISH: Industrials and Healthcare (broad weakness and large-cap selling).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA resistance area to signal sustained recovery; NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) — break above recent 1M high would be notable. AAPL support test: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.53% | 1M: -0.61%) — hold above ~$170 would stabilize. XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%) — sustained push above recent pivot would confirm Energy leadership. OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) — monitor for follow-through on analyst upgrades.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (+65): NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -0.48%) — bullish China approval news but price is not confirming (divergence).  
OXY (+55): OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%) — analyst upgrades and oil tailwinds confirming price strength.  
UBER (+50): UBER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +11.14%) — Nvidia partnership headlines confirming upside momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ADBE (-60): ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -3.70%) — CEO exit/downgrade and price weakness confirm downside.  
META (-50): META BELOW TREND (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -2.59%) — downgrade headlines align with recent selling.  
NEM (-45): NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -11.55%) — gold/commodity weakness and price decline are confirming.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy).  
Energy names showing relative strength: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +25.90%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.21% | 1M: +6.98%).  
Key risk: major divergence in select large caps (TSLA, UNH, PFE) and bullish NVDA news while NVDA remains BELOW TREND — monitor for trend confirmation.
